name: OmaKube
author: OmaKube
description: Kubernetes contexts, namespaces, workloads, logs and quick actions — single anchored popup in the Omarchy bar.

barWidget.description: Active k8s context pill with health dot; click for the full Kubernetes popup.

schema.label: Kubeconfig override
schema.description: Optional. Leave empty to use $KUBECONFIG or ~/.kube/config like kubectl.

schema.label: Log export directory
schema.description: Where log-tail exports are saved. Defaults to ~/omakube-logs.

schema.label: Read-only mode
schema.description: Disables all mutating actions (restart, kill pod, port-forward).

schema.label: Debug logging
schema.description: Verbose backend logging for connection/auth troubleshooting.
